title: Storage URL restrictions for credential-less warehouse tables
answers: Can a credential-less data warehouse table be repointed to another URL?
Where is the PostHog internal storage URL restriction enforced for warehouse tables?
What are the security constraints on url_pattern for uploaded warehouse tables?
body:
Credential-less warehouse tables read via the ClickHouse node role and must never be created with or repointed to arbitrary PostHog internal storage URLs.
Enforced in products/data_warehouse/backend/presentation/views/table.py:TableSerializer.validate_url_pattern: such tables may only retain their existing, system-generated url_pattern upon update.
If skipped, tenants could point warehouse tables at arbitrary PostHog internal storage locations and read unauthorized internal data using node role credentials.
applies: URL pattern validation for data warehouse tables in TableSerializer.
says: Prevent uploaded data warehouse tables from pointing to unauthorized internal cloud storage
Security error when attempting to modify the file storage location on tables
Uploaded warehouse tables must not be redirected to arbitrary system bucket paths
Restrict file data warehouse sources from accessing internal application storage folders
